# Goofy player library

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_goofy_docs.py from src/gate/goofy_params.inc + goofy_player_params.inc. Do not edit by hand. -->

Goofy exposes **195 player params**: every `PlayerFeel` export that is not part of the ball library
(194 of them: movement, jump, sprint / stamina, dive / fall, block, serve, animation, visuals and
contact timing) plus Goofy's own `player.body_scale`. The 27 ball-contact PlayerFeel params (hit range, hitboxes,
player gravity / jump height) stay in the ball library (docs/GOOFY-BALL.md) so FIXED keeps working for them.

## What you can read and edit
| area | read | edit |
|---|---|---|
| movement, speed, sprint, stamina | `goofy_player_state` (velocity, speed, sprinting, stamina, grounded) | `player.move_speed`, `player.accel*`, `player.sprint_*`, `player.stamina_*`, `player.strafe_*` |
| jump | `goofy_player_state` (grounded) | `player.jump_*`, `player.apex_*`, `player.bam_*` (+ `player.gravity` / jump velocities in the ball library) |
| dive, fall, block | `goofy_player_state` (dive_cooldown) | `player.dive_*`, `player.tumble_*`, `player.block_*` |
| hitbox / reach | - | ball library `player.reach`, `player.block_radius`, ... (docs/GOOFY-BALL.md) |
| scale | `goofy_player_state` (scale, body_scale) | `player.body_scale` (0.25 .. 4, every player node: visual + collision) |
| animation | `goofy_player_state.anim` = `{clip, pos, speed}` of the player's rig; events `goofy_player_event` (swung, jumped, launched, thumped, knock_started, dove_into_net, ...) | `player.pose_*`, `player.recoil_*`, `player.crouch_*`, `player.land_*`, ... |
| cosmetics state | `goofy_player_cosmetics`: name, number, skin tone, hair, worn accessories per slot, the whole look, shown custom model (local player) | read-only here (cosmetics are edited by the locker / packs) |

## How it reaches the game
* `player.*` -> the game's shared `res://game/player/player_feel.tres` (`static var FEEL`, player.gd:18), written
  through CORE under the capability `player.tuning` (restores use the undo path). Values are read by the game at
  use, so changes are live. Integer params (`player.contact_queue_steps`) are rounded.
* `player.body_scale` -> every Player node's scale (CORE `node_set_scale`, capability `player.scale`), live:
  a new value rescales from each player's original scale; 1.0 puts them back. The old config key
  `player_scale` is the same param.
* Animation / event hooks are the game's own signals (player.gd:126-162) connected through CORE
  (`connect_player_event`) and relayed as `goofy_player_event` with the player index and the signal args.

## Where the values are live
* **Offline** (Free Play, practice, offline solo, the menu): your own layers (config, court, mods).
* **LAN / private / friends-only lobbies:** in the lobby you play your own layers. From **match start**
  (or lobby practice) to **match end**, every **gameplay** param (column `sync` = host: hitboxes,
  gravity, drag, bounce, spin, speed caps, movement, jump, ...) and the time scale are the **host's**
  effective values on every modded player; each client simulates them locally, so its prediction
  matches. **Visual-only** params (column `sync` = visual (own): the visuals sections and every
  colour) stay each player's own. At match end, or when the host leaves, your own values come back
  (docs/GOOFY-SYNC.md). An unmodded player in the lobby is unaffected (the game itself is never sent
  anything).
* **Public / quick match / server browser:** never. Everything is stock (CORE gate rule: local-only).
* Originals are captured before the first edit and restored exactly when a param goes back to stock,
  when the gate closes or when the libraries stop being allowed.

## Editing
* **Your config** (`mods/goofy/*.json`): a `player_params` block (same value forms as `ball_params`):
```json
{
  "player_scale": 1.25,
  "player_params": {
    "player.move_speed": 7.0,
    "player.sprint_speed": { "mul": 1.3 },
    "player.indicator_color": [1.0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0]
  }
}
```
* **A court pack's `goofy` block** may carry player ids too (owner `pack:<id>`).
* **Other mods:** `goofy_player_set_override(mod, params, priority, scope)` (capability `goofy.player`, offline;
  layer owner `mod:<name>:player`), `goofy_player_clear_override(mod)`. Ball ids sent there are refused (and
  player ids sent to `goofy_set_override` likewise), so each layer stays in its own library.
* Precedence per param: stock < your config (100) < court pack (200) < mods (default 500, 0..899).

## Params
Defaults are the game's (recovered scripts, build 26827091); the stock value is read from the live resource.
Ranges are ours (mostly 0 .. 5x stock; signed values -10x .. 10x).

| `player.body_scale` | goofy | 1 | 0.25 | 4 | x | node_scale | host |

## Host sync classification
190 of the 195 player params are **gameplay** (they alter the ball or a player) and follow the host
during a synced match; 5 are **visual-only** (trail, outline, rings, indicator colours) and stay each player's own:

`player.indicator_color`, `player.dive_ring_color`, `player.stamina_empty_color`, `player.ring_jump`, `player.ring_serve`.

Rule: a param is visual-only when it is a colour or sits in a `visuals` section; everything else is gameplay
(when in doubt, gameplay: e.g. the animation section also holds `player.dump_tilt`, which decides dump shots).

## Rule switches
* `PlayerFeel.block_classic` (stock off) is a rule switch, not a tunable: it is the gameplay setting
  `goofy.rules.block_classic` ("Classic block (no zones, the stuff goes to the cursor)") in the Settings panel's
  mods tab, host-synced and back to stock on revert. See docs/GOOFY-RULES.md.

## Not editable here
* GDScript `const`s in player.gd (compiled into the script).
* Cosmetics (look, outfit, accessories, models) are read-only in this API; the locker, texture packs and
  model packs own them.
